rule_text.name: 701.80a
rule_text.rule: Conjure is a keyword action. “Conjure (number) cards named (name) to (zone)” means “Put (number) cards named (name) into (zone).”

rule_text.name: 701.80b
rule_text.rule: “Conjure (number) of a random (quality) card to (zone)” means “Put (number) cards of a single (quality) card chosen at random into (zone).”

rule_text.name: 701.80c
rule_text.rule: “Conjure a random (quality) card to (zone) (number) times” means “Repeat this process (number) times. Put a (quality) card chosen at random into (zone)”

rule_text.name: 701.80d
rule_text.rule: To “conjure a duplicate” of an object, conjure the card that has the same name, alternative name, interchangeable name, or name of back face as that object. If such a card does not exist, for example, it is a token named after its types, no card will be conjured.

rule_text.name: 701.80e
rule_text.rule: Conjured cards are not moved from any zone or a player's sideboard.

rule_text.name: 701.80f
rule_text.rule: Conjured cards are cards and not tokens, even if they are represented by token or checklists cards.

rule_text.name: 701.80g
rule_text.rule: Conjured cards are known to all players, even if they are conjured to a hidden zone.

rule_text.name: 701.80h
rule_text.rule: The owner of a conjured card is the player who conjured it, regardless of who controlled the effect that caused that player to conjure it.

rule_text.name: 701.80i
rule_text.rule: When a game ends, cards that were conjured during that game are removed from decks.

rule_text.name: 701.80j
rule_text.rule: When a game is restarted, cards that were conjured during that game remain in decks.
